The scalar-particle analysis of さえ and the “extreme/minimal case” generalization require a Japanese grammar/semantics source with polarity-sensitive examples; none was checked.

The listed translations “hasta/incluso/ni siquiera/con tal de/basta con” appear to conflate distinct constructions and may need subdivision into separate senses/constructions and exact particles/condition patterns.
